why: Replacing C6 caused the model to avoid cuts that would drop essential post‑nominal modifiers or appositives; measured against the prior near‑miss this edit has almost no net effect overall (vs_base mean Δ=0.00078, CI includes zero) but does hurt very short pieces (≤3: −0.0076) while improving longer spans (≤5..≤99: +0.0074..+0.0105), i.e. many examples moved cuts away from modifiers (improving cohesion) but in some short cases the cuts were pushed into positions that split heads/verbs or small NPs and so worsened H_set (roughly balanced: 676 worse vs 698 better).
lesson: Keep the protection against dropping essential post‑nominal modifiers and appositives (it improves longer spans), but avoid forcing cuts into very short segments where they end up splitting heads from their dependents.
